reuse.why: Routes every copy of the range-amount logic (schedule-template, forecast normalizeSchedule, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview) through the existing shared getScheduledAmount.

duplication.why: Removes four inline midpoint copies and implements the furthest-from-zero rule once in the shared helper.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where getScheduledAmount already sits and is consumed by both server and client code.

scope.why: Only the rule change, the consolidation needed for it to apply everywhere, and focused tests.

maintainability.why: A future change to how ranges are planned is a one-line edit in one function covered by unit tests.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, now called by schedule-template.ts, forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts (two sites), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and the existing client callers
